# Spain Valencia Crop Fields

Spain Valencia field boundaries (2024) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Spanish Agricultural Guarantee Fund (FEGA) of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Food. License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_vc/latest/es_vc.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_vc/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:25830; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: admin_province_code, crop:name, collection, crop:name_en, metrics:area, admin_municipality_code, crop:code, geometry, id, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_vc/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_vc/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_vc/collection.json
